explanation_ne: दोस्रो सामान्य रूप (2NF) ले आंशिक निर्भरता हटाउँछ, जहाँ गैर-कुञ्जी विशेषता कम्पोजिट किको एक भागमा मात्र निर्भर हुन्छ।

question: Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for routing?
question_ne: OSI मोडेलको कुन तह राउटिङका लागि जिम्मेवार छ?
explanation: The network layer (Layer 3) handles routing and logical addressing (IP).
explanation_ne: नेटवर्क तह (तह ३) ले राउटिङ र तार्किक ठेगाना (IP) हेर्छ।
source: BSc CSIT Entrance — TU IOST syllabus

question: How many layers are there in the OSI model?
question_ne: OSI मोडेलमा कति तह छन्?
explanation: The OSI model has 7 layers: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation and Application.
explanation_ne: OSI मोडेलमा ७ तह छन्: फिजिकल, डाटा लिङ्क, नेटवर्क, ट्रान्सपोर्ट, सेसन, प्रेजेन्टेसन र एप्लिकेसन।
source: BSc CSIT Entrance — TU IOST syllabus

question: Which protocol assigns IP addresses automatically to devices on a network?
question_ne: नेटवर्कमा उपकरणलाई स्वचालित रूपमा IP ठेगाना दिने प्रोटोकल कुन हो?
explanation: DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) assigns IP addresses automatically.
explanation_ne: DHCP (डाइनामिक होस्ट कन्फिगरेसन प्रोटोकल) ले IP ठेगाना स्वचालित रूपमा दिन्छ।

question: An IPv4 address has how many bits?
question_ne: IPv4 ठेगानामा कति बिट हुन्छ?
explanation: An IPv4 address is 32 bits long; IPv6 addresses are 128 bits.
explanation_ne: IPv4 ठेगाना ३२ बिट लामो हुन्छ; IPv6 ठेगाना १२८ बिट हुन्छ।
source: BSc CSIT Entrance — TU IOST syllabus

question: Which device connects two different networks and routes packets between them?

explanation: A router connects different networks and forwards packets between them using IP addresses.
explanation_ne: राउटरले फरक नेटवर्क जोड्छ र IP ठेगाना प्रयोग गरी प्याकेट अर्को नेटवर्कमा पठाउँछ।
source: BSc CSIT Entrance — TU IOST syllabus

question: HTML stands for what?

source: BSc CSIT Entrance — TU IOST syllabus

question: CSS is used for what in web pages?
question_ne: वेब पृष्ठमा CSS केका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ?
explanation: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) controls the styling, colours and layout of web pages.
explanation_ne: CSS (क्यास्केडिङ स्टाइल सिट) ले वेब पृष्ठको स्टाइल, रङ र लेआउट नियन्त्रण गर्छ।
source: BSc CSIT Entrance — TU IOST syllabus

question: Which language runs in the browser to make web pages interactive?

explanation: JavaScript runs in the browser and makes web pages interactive.

source: BSc CSIT Entrance — TU IOST syllabus

question: Which of the following is a compiled language?
question_ne: निम्नमध्ये कुन कम्पाइल हुने भाषा हो?

question: What is 1010 in binary plus 0101 in binary?

explanation: 1010 + 0101 = 1111 in binary (10 + 5 = 15 in decimal).

question: Which logic gate outputs 1 only when both inputs are 1?
question_ne: कुन लजिक गेटले दुवै इनपुट १ हुँदा मात्र १ दिन्छ?
explanation: An AND gate outputs 1 only when all its inputs are 1.

question: Which logic gate outputs 1 when at least one input is 1?
question_ne: कुन लजिक गेटले कम्तीमा एक इनपुट १ हुँदा १ दिन्छ?
explanation: An OR gate outputs 1 when at least one input is 1.

question: Which logic gate inverts its input?
question_ne: कुन लजिक गेटले इनपुट उल्टाउँछ?
explanation: A NOT gate outputs the opposite of its input: 1 becomes 0 and 0 becomes 1.

question: The 2's complement of binary 0101 is what?
question_ne: बाइनरी ०१०१ को २'s कम्प्लिमेन्ट कति हो?
explanation: 1's complement of 0101 is 1010; adding 1 gives the 2's complement 1011.
explanation_ne: ०१०१ को १'s कम्प्लिमेन्ट १०१० हो; १ थप्दा २'s कम्प्लिमेन्ट १०११ हुन्छ।
source: BSc CSIT Entrance — TU IOST syllabus

question: What is the time complexity of binary search on a sorted array?
question_ne: सर्टेड एरेमा बाइनरी सर्चको समय जटिलता कति हो?
explanation: Binary search halves the search space each step, so it runs in O(log n) time.
explanation_ne: बाइनरी सर्चले प्रत्येक चरणमा खोज क्षेत्र आधा गर्छ, त्यसैले यो O(log n) समयमा चल्छ।
source: BSc CSIT Entrance — TU IOST syllabus

question: Which search algorithm works only on a sorted list?

explanation: Binary search requires a sorted list; linear search works on any list.

source: BSc CSIT Entrance — TU IOST syllabus

question: A linked list is best described as what?

explanation: A linked list is a collection of nodes, each holding data and a pointer to the next node.

question: In a binary tree, each node has at most how many children?

explanation: In a binary tree, each node has at most two children (left and right).

question: Which traversal of a binary search tree gives the keys in sorted order?

explanation: In-order traversal of a binary search tree visits keys in ascending sorted order.

source: BSc CSIT Entrance — TU IOST syllabus

question: What does OOP stand for?

explanation: OOP stands for Object-Oriented Programming.

question: Which is NOT a pillar of object-oriented programming?
question_ne: निम्नमध्ये कुन अब्जेक्ट-ओरिएन्टेड प्रोग्रामिङको स्तम्भ होइन?

question: Encapsulation in OOP means what?
question_ne: OOP मा इन्क्याप्सुलेसन भनेको के हो?
options: Bundling data and methods that operate on it into one unit
Using the same method name differently
options_ne: डाटा र त्यसमा काम गर्ने विधिलाई एक एकाइमा बाँध्नु
एउटै विधिको नाम फरक तरिकाले प्रयोग गर्नु
explanation: Encapsulation bundles data and the methods that operate on it into a single unit (a class) and restricts direct access.
explanation_ne: इन्क्याप्सुलेसनले डाटा र त्यसमा काम गर्ने विधिलाई एक एकाइ (वर्ग) मा बाँध्छ र प्रत्यक्ष पहुँच सीमित गर्छ।

question: Inheritance in OOP allows what?

options: A class to acquire properties of another class
options_ne: एउटा वर्गले अर्को वर्गका गुण प्राप्त गर्न

explanation_ne: इन्हेरिटेन्सले एउटा वर्ग (सन्तान) लाई अर्को वर्ग (अभिभावक) का गुण र विधि प्राप्त गर्न दिन्छ।

question: Polymorphism in OOP means what?

explanation: The speed of light in a vacuum is about 3 × 10⁸ m/s.
explanation_ne: शून्यतामा प्रकाशको गति करिब ३ × १०⁸ मि/से हुन्छ।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: Sound travels fastest through which medium?
question_ne: ध्वनि कुन माध्यमबाट सबैभन्दा छिटो चल्छ?
explanation: Sound travels fastest in solids, slower in liquids and slowest in gases; it cannot travel in a vacuum.
explanation_ne: ध्वनि ठोसमा सबैभन्दा छिटो, तरलमा ढिलो र ग्यासमा सबैभन्दा ढिलो चल्छ; शून्यतामा चल्न सक्दैन।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: The phenomenon of light bending as it passes from one medium to another is called what?
question_ne: प्रकाश एक माध्यमबाट अर्कोमा जाँदा बाङ्गिनुलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: Refraction is the bending of light when it passes from one medium into another of different density.
explanation_ne: अपवर्तन भनेको प्रकाश फरक घनत्वको एक माध्यमबाट अर्कोमा जाँदा बाङ्गिनु हो।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: The splitting of white light into its colours is called what?
question_ne: सेतो प्रकाशलाई यसका रङमा छुट्याउनुलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: Dispersion splits white light into its component colours, as in a prism forming a spectrum.
explanation_ne: विक्षेपणले सेतो प्रकाशलाई यसका रङमा छुट्याउँछ, जस्तै प्रिज्मले वर्णक्रम बनाउँछ।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: The SI unit of frequency is what?
question_ne: आवृत्तिको SI एकाइ के हो?
explanation: Frequency is measured in hertz (Hz), the number of cycles per second.
explanation_ne: आवृत्ति हर्ट्ज (Hz) मा नापिन्छ, प्रति सेकेन्ड चक्र संख्या।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: The time period of a wave is the reciprocal of what?
question_ne: तरङ्गको आवर्तकाल कुनको व्युत्क्रम हो?
explanation: Time period T = 1/frequency.
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: Ohm's law states that V equals what?
question_ne: ओह्मको नियमले V के बराबर हुन्छ भन्छ?
explanation: Ohm's law: V = IR (voltage = current × resistance).
explanation_ne: ओह्मको नियम: V = IR (भोल्टेज = विद्युत् × प्रतिरोध)।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: Electrical resistance is measured in which unit?
question_ne: विद्युत् प्रतिरोध कुन एकाइमा नापिन्छ?
explanation: Resistance is measured in ohms (Ω).
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: In a series circuit, the current through each component is what?
question_ne: श्रेणी सर्किटमा प्रत्येक घटकबाट बग्ने विद्युत् कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation: In a series circuit the same current flows through every component.
explanation_ne: श्रेणी सर्किटमा प्रत्येक घटकबाट एउटै विद्युत् बग्छ।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: Which instrument measures voltage?
question_ne: भोल्टेज नाप्ने उपकरण कुन हो?
explanation: A voltmeter measures voltage and is connected in parallel.
explanation_ne: भोल्टमिटरले भोल्टेज नाप्छ र समानान्तरमा जोडिन्छ।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: The chemical symbol for common salt is what?
question_ne: साधारण नुनको रासायनिक सङ्केत के हो?
explanation: Common salt is sodium chloride, NaCl.
explanation_ne: साधारण नुन सोडियम क्लोराइड, NaCl हो।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: The atomic number of carbon is what?
question_ne: कार्बनको परमाणु संख्या कति हो?
explanation: Carbon has atomic number 6 and atomic mass about 12.
explanation_ne: कार्बनको परमाणु संख्या ६ र परमाणु भार करिब १२ हुन्छ।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: The atomic number of oxygen is what?
question_ne: अक्सिजनको परमाणु संख्या कति हो?
explanation: Oxygen has atomic number 8 and atomic mass about 16.
explanation_ne: अक्सिजनको परमाणु संख्या ८ र परमाणु भार करिब १६ हुन्छ।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: The gas released when an acid reacts with a metal is usually which gas?
question_ne: अम्लले धातुसँग प्रतिक्रिया गर्दा प्रायः कुन ग्यास निस्कन्छ?
explanation: Acids react with most metals to release hydrogen gas.
explanation_ne: अम्लले धेरैजसो धातुसँग प्रतिक्रिया गरी हाइड्रोजन ग्यास निकाल्छ।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: Which gas is used in the Haber process to make ammonia?
question_ne: अमोनिया बनाउने हेबर प्रक्रियामा कुन ग्यास प्रयोग हुन्छ?
explanation: The Haber process combines nitrogen and hydrogen to make ammonia (NH₃).
explanation_ne: हेबर प्रक्रियाले नाइट्रोजन र हाइड्रोजन मिलाएर अमोनिया (NH₃) बनाउँछ।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: The chemical formula of methane is what?
question_ne: मिथेनको रासायनिक सूत्र के हो?
explanation: Methane is CH₄: one carbon atom and four hydrogen atoms.
explanation_ne: मिथेन CH₄ हो: एक कार्बन परमाणु र चार हाइड्रोजन परमाणु।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: The first element in the periodic table is which?
question_ne: आवर्त तालिकाको पहिलो तत्त्व कुन हो?
explanation: Hydrogen (atomic number 1) is the first element in the periodic table.
explanation_ne: हाइड्रोजन (परमाणु संख्या १) आवर्त तालिकाको पहिलो तत्त्व हो।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: How many groups are there in the modern periodic table?
question_ne: आधुनिक आवर्त तालिकामा कति समूह छन्?
explanation: The modern periodic table has 18 groups and 7 periods.
explanation_ne: आधुनिक आवर्त तालिकामा १८ समूह र ७ आवर्त छन्।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: How many periods are there in the modern periodic table?
question_ne: आधुनिक आवर्त तालिकामा कति आवर्त छन्?
explanation: The modern periodic table has 7 periods and 18 groups.
explanation_ne: आधुनिक आवर्त तालिकामा ७ आवर्त र १८ समूह छन्।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: The value of log₁₀ 100 is what?
question_ne: log₁₀ 100 को मान कति हो?
explanation: log₁₀ 100 = 2, because 10² = 100.
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: The value of log₁₀ 1000 is what?
question_ne: log₁₀ 1000 को मान कति हो?
explanation: log₁₀ 1000 = 3, because 10³ = 1000.
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: The sum of the angles of a triangle is how many degrees?
question_ne: त्रिभुजका कोणहरूको योग कति डिग्री हुन्छ?
explanation: The interior angles of a triangle sum to 180°.
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: The sum of the angles of a quadrilateral is how many degrees?
question_ne: चतुर्भुजका कोणहरूको योग कति डिग्री हुन्छ?
explanation: The interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to 360°.
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: The area of a circle of radius r is given by which formula?
question_ne: त्रिज्या r भएको वृत्तको क्षेत्रफल कुन सूत्रले दिइन्छ?
explanation: Area of a circle = πr²; circumference = 2πr.
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: The circumference of a circle of radius r is given by which formula?
question_ne: त्रिज्या r भएको वृत्तको परिधि कुन सूत्रले दिइन्छ?
explanation: Circumference = 2πr; area = πr².
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: In engineering drawing, the top view is also called what?
question_ne: इन्जिनियरिङ रेखाचित्रमा टप भ्यु लाई के पनि भनिन्छ?
explanation: The top view is called the plan; the front view is the elevation.
explanation_ne: टप भ्यु लाई प्लान भनिन्छ; फ्रन्ट भ्यु लाई एलिभेसन भनिन्छ।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: In engineering drawing, the front view is also called what?
question_ne: इन्जिनियरिङ रेखाचित्रमा फ्रन्ट भ्यु लाई के पनि भनिन्छ?
explanation: The front view is called the elevation; the top view is the plan.
explanation_ne: फ्रन्ट भ्यु लाई एलिभेसन भनिन्छ; टप भ्यु लाई प्लान भनिन्छ।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: An isometric view shows an object in how many dimensions?
question_ne: आइसोमेट्रिक भ्युले वस्तुलाई कति आयाममा देखाउँछ?
explanation: An isometric view shows an object in three dimensions (length, width and height).
explanation_ne: आइसोमेट्रिक भ्युले वस्तुलाई तीन आयाममा (लम्बाइ, चौडाइ र उचाइ) देखाउँछ।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: In first-angle projection, the object is placed in which quadrant?
question_ne: फर्स्ट-एङ्गल प्रोजेक्सनमा वस्तु कुन चतुर्थांशमा राखिन्छ?
explanation: In first-angle projection the object is placed in the first quadrant, above the horizontal plane and in front of the vertical plane.
explanation_ne: फर्स्ट-एङ्गल प्रोजेक्सनमा वस्तु पहिलो चतुर्थांशमा, तेर्सो तलभन्दा माथि र ठाडो तलबाट अगाडि राखिन्छ।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: In third-angle projection, the object is placed in which quadrant?
question_ne: थर्ड-एङ्गल प्रोजेक्सनमा वस्तु कुन चतुर्थांशमा राखिन्छ?
explanation: In third-angle projection the object is placed in the third quadrant.
explanation_ne: थर्ड-एङ्गल प्रोजेक्सनमा वस्तु तेस्रो चतुर्थांशमा राखिन्छ।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: Which line type is used for hidden edges in engineering drawing?
question_ne: इन्जिनियरिङ रेखाचित्रमा लुकेका किनाराका लागि कुन रेखा प्रयोग हुन्छ?
explanation: Hidden edges are shown with dashed (short-dash) lines.
explanation_ne: लुकेका किनारा ड्यास्ड (छोटो ड्यास) रेखाले देखाइन्छ।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: Which line type is used for the centre line of a circle?
question_ne: वृत्तको केन्द्र रेखाका लागि कुन रेखा प्रयोग हुन्छ?
explanation: Centre lines are drawn as long-dash short-dash (chain) lines.
explanation_ne: केन्द्र रेखा लामो-ड्यास छोटो-ड्यास (चेन) रेखाले कोइन्छ।
source: IOE Entrance — TU Institute of Engineering syllabus

question: How many marks is the Mathematics section worth in the IOE entrance?

question_ne: IOE प्रवेश परीक्षामा भौतिकशास्त्र खण्ड कति अङ्कको हुन्छ?

question: Which of the following is a correct sentence?
question_ne: निम्नमध्ये कुन सही वाक्य हो?
options: She is study for two hours.
She have been studying for two hours.
She has being studying for two hours.
She has been studying for two hours.
options_ne: उनी दुई घण्टादेखि अध्ययन गरिरहेका छन्।
उनी दुई घण्टादेखि अध्ययन भइरहेकी छिन्।
उनी दुई घण्टादेखि अध्ययन गरिरहेकी छिन्।
explanation: 'She has been studying for two hours' is the correct present perfect continuous form.
explanation_ne: 'She has been studying for two hours' सही प्रेजेन्ट पर्फेक्ट कन्टिन्युअस रूप हो।

question: Choose the correct passive voice of 'The teacher praised the student.'
question_ne: 'The teacher praised the student.' को सही कर्मवाच्य कुन हो?

The student is praised by the teacher.
The student has praised by the teacher.
The teacher was praised by the student.
explanation: The passive of the past simple 'praised' is 'was praised'.
